name: Yandex Calendar
description: Reminders before your Yandex Calendar events, and a summary of your day each morning. This plugin only ever reads your calendar: it never creates, changes or deletes anything in it.

settings_schema.header:
Sends each connected user a reminder before their Yandex Calendar events and a summary of their day each morning.

The plugin is read-only. It asks each user only for permission to read their calendar's events (`calendar:events.read`), and never writes to anyone's calendar. Yandex's calendar API is in early access, so Yandex must approve your application before anyone can connect. See the [administrator setup guide](https://github.com/maunty/mattermost-yandex360-calendar/blob/master/docs/admin-setup.md) for how to register the Yandex application.
settings_schema.footer: Once the client ID and secret are set, users connect with `/yacal connect`.

settings.help_text: The ID of the Yandex OAuth application registered at oauth.yandex.ru. Until this is set, the plugin does nothing.
The secret of the Yandex OAuth application. Until this is set, the plugin does nothing.
How long before an event starts its reminder is sent. Applies to every user on this server.
The key used to encrypt Yandex tokens in the plugin's key-value store. Regenerating it disconnects every user, who will have to run /yacal connect again.
